summary.text: Drew Stokesbary is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 31-Position 1 since January 2015 and serving as House minority leader since 2023, who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Stephen Szczurko-Walton.

paragraphs.text: Drew Stokesbary earned a B.S. in economics from Duke University and a J.D. cum laude from the University of Notre Dame Law School.
Professionally, he works as a policy aide with the King County Council.
Stokesbary assumed office in the Washington House on January 12, 2015, and began serving as state House minority leader in 2023.
His 2023-2024 committee assignments included the Appropriations Committee and the House Rules Committee.
